entities.name: Maurício Agostinho Camuto
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maurício Agostinho Camuto, C.S.Sp. is an Angolan bishop of the Catholic Church and a member of the Spiritans. He is the bishop of the Diocese of Caxito, having been appointed to the position in 2020. He previously served as the director of Radio Ecclesia, a Catholic commercial radio station in Angola.
